game.name: Parlour
game.author: Braedon Saunders (canonical Parlour); Crossroads adapters
game.description: A full card room: Klondike, FreeCell, Spider, Pyramid, Golf, TriPeaks, Hearts, Spades, Euchre, Oh Hell, Pinochle, Scopa, Crazy Eights, Wild, President, Palace, Durak, Spite & Malice, Rat Screw, Gin Rummy, Cribbage, Blitz, and Poker — solo or against bots, with your progress saved.
